description: Imagine a robot moving into your home. How would it change your daily life? Historian Emily Kate Genatowski shares five eye-opening lessons from a year living with her AI-powered robot roommate, from the quirky and chaotic to the surprisingly mundane. Her experiences show that the future of robots isn’t science fiction — it’s practical, messy and already here. Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
classificationReason: Centers on a year-long lived experience with an AI-powered household robot.
qualityReason: Focused firsthand account organized around five practical lessons, with concrete incidents involving liability, transport, home damage, social acceptance, work deployment, and regulation.
